script_text: Stop, Pisces — Neptune is buzzing with unfinished business and it demands your attention right now. Your ruling planet Neptune, the deep ocean of your watery soul, sits at 5° Aries in your 2nd House of Finances, forming a tense square to expansive Jupiter in Cancer resting in your 5th House of Creativity, forcing you to choose between security and self-expression. Mars stirs in that same 2nd House, putting your income and resources under real pressure. In love, the Virgo transit awakening your 7th House of Partnerships means someone from your past is reappearing with genuine intentions and hidden depth. Career-wise, Mercury cutting through your 10th House of Public Standing signals a professional opportunity that could significantly reshape your earnings trajectory. Avoid signing any financial documents before midnight — a hidden detail is about to emerge. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
